tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rlung sems gnad kyi lde mig /

༄༅// "$ oṃ sarba swa sti siddhi hūṃ/ ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'i/ rlung sems kyi gdams ngag gnad kyi lde mig 'di la rtsa ba'i chings rnam pa gsum ni/ ngan rtog yid la byed pas gzung na/ de rtsa nang du 'phel bas/ sdug bsngal 'byung*/ bzang rtog yid la byed dus rlung bzung na yon tan skye la/ yid byed yid smon sna tshogs dang bral bas rlung gnad du tshud na skad cig gis phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa 'char zhing*/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya'o// de la rgyas par bshad na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ rags pa tsam phye na/ ngan rtog la nyon mongs pa dug lnga dang*/ bdud bzhi'i rgyu tshul shes dgos te/ zhe sdang skyes dus rlung 'bud ma shes na pho gdon gyis gnod/ nad gzer lta bu dang*/ bu slob 'khrug pa dang*/ mi dum pa sna tshogs 'byung*/ de bzhin du 'dod chags phyir 'bud ma shes na/ mo gdon gyi gnod/ nad grang pa 'jug /sdom pa mi thub/ 'khor sdom shor dang khrims rkun 'ong*/ gti mug phyir 'bud ma shes na/ sa gdon gnod/ bad kan dang mdze nad yong*/ 'khor mdze nad can 'ong*/ nga rgyal phyir 'bud ma shes na/ rgyal 'gong gnod/ bsnyos 'bog yong*/ sdom pa mi thub/ rang dang 'khor ngan par ltung*/ phrag dog phyir 'bud ma shes na/ sbod gtong gnod/ byad ka dang nad yams 'ong*/ 'khor gzhan gyi dbang du 'gro/ bdud bzhi'i gnas tshul ni/ lha'i bu'i bdud rtsa mig la gnas/ nam langs khar rgyu/ rgyal 'gong dang bsdongs/ rtags shes pa yangs mthos ba dang 'gro snying 'dod pa 'ong*/ gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud/ rtsa mig tu bla ma bsgom/ phung po'i bdud pha rus la gnas/ nyi ma phyed la rgyu/ sa bdag dang bsdong rtags shes pa nyog /khams nyog po 'ong*/ gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud khu khrag la gnas/ dus dgongs kha rgyu/ mo gdon dang bsdong*/ rtags snying mi dga' ba 'ong*/

gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud*/ lte bar bla ma bsgom 'chi bdag gi bdud rlung la gnas/ dus nam phyed la rgyu/ rbad 'dre dang bsdong*/ rtags bred dngas dang snying phugs 'ong*/ gnyen po rlung phyir 'bud/ snying khar bla ma bsgom/ nad gdon gegs sel thams cad 'dis 'gre'o// bzang rtog bye brag la mos gus/ snying rje/ zhen log /bskyed rdzogs/ bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs skyes dus rlung phyir bus na/ de'i nus pa nyams shing dngos grub yal bas de'i dus su rlung sems nang du bsdud dgos so// de yang mos gus skyes dus rlung phyir bus na/ bla mas thugs la mi 'dogs/ snying rje skyes dus phyir bus na sems can gyi don mi 'grub/ zhen log skyes dus phyir bus na zas nor mi 'du/ bskyed rims bsgom dus phyir bus na yid dam mi 'grub/ sngags bzlo dus phyir bus na nus pa mi 'byung*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa skyes dus phyir bus na ting nge 'dzin mi skye/ dge ba'i dus rlung nang du bsdus na dbang bskur gsum dang*/ bsre ba bskor gsum lta bur nyams su len dgos pa yin/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad rlung sems kyi rten 'brel yin/ de la sogs pa rlung sems kyi rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams nyams su len shes par bya'o// yid la byed pa thams cad dang bral ba dang*/ rlung sems phyag rgya chen po dang 'brel pa mchog gi gtum mo yin pas/ gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bsgom mo// mdor na rlung sems ngan pa thams cad phyir bus/ bzang po thams cad nang du bsdu'o// thams cad dbyer med ro gcig du mnyam par bzhag go /chos rje rin po che karma pa'i rlung sems gnad kyi gdams pa zab mo lags so/// /
